Bollywood Film 'Ramayan' to Release Trailer Three Months Before Release Date

The makers of the upcoming Bollywood film 'Ramayan', starring Rana Daggubati, have announced that they will release a trailer three months before the film's scheduled release date. The decision has sparked debate among fans and critics about the film's marketing strategy. The film is set to be released in Delhi instead of Mumbai, which has raised questions about the film's production and distribution. The trailer's release date has also been confirmed as March 15th.
